paragraphs: Mentioned in Kiddushin 17a; Hyman says without doubt that the name should read bar Peda. See the entry R' Yehudah ben Pedayah, and [Tosafot on Chullin 124b](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosafot_on_Chullin.124b.21.1), beginning “Rav Papa said.”[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The linked Tosafot begins “Rav Papa said.”
Hyman expresses certainty about the correction to bar Peda. The supplied heading has Peda.

Kiddushin 54b gives the name Bar Peda in reports by Ulla and Ravin. Heilprin cites this passage. The name at Hyman’s cited Kiddushin 17a remains unverified. See [Kiddushin 54b](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.54b.2-3). See [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2933&lang=en).
